svg.title: Technical stack
svg.desc: Languages: Python, SQL, Bash, Java, C, C++, Swift, JavaScript, TypeScript. Mobile: Flutter, Dart, Kotlin, BLoC. Web and API: React, Node.js, FastAPI. Data: PostgreSQL, SQLite, MongoDB. Tools: Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS, Git, GitHub, Bitbucket, Jira, pytest. Agents: LangGraph, LangChain, Deep Agents, local LLMs, hybrid RAG, context engineering, agentic workflows.
